entities.name: Procedures related to EPS bearer contexts
entities.description: Network-initiated procedures for manipulation of EPS bearer contexts including default/dedicated bearer activation, modification, and deactivation.

entities.name: Transaction related procedures
entities.description: UE-initiated procedures for requesting or releasing resources including PDN connectivity/disconnect and bearer resource allocation/modification.

entities.name: Transport of user data via the control plane procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by network or UE for transporting user data via control plane.

entities.name: PDN connectivity procedure
entities.description: UE-initiated procedure to request a new PDN connection.

entities.name: ESM information request procedure
entities.description: Transaction related procedure triggered by network when PDN connectivity procedure is combined with attach.

entities.name: ESM dummy message procedure
entities.description: Transaction related procedure executed when no PDN connectivity procedure is initiated during attach with EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection support.

entities.name: Remote UE report procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by ProSe UE-to-network relay for manipulation of EPS bearer contexts.

entities.name: ESM status procedure
entities.description: ESM procedure that can be related to an EPS bearer context or procedure transaction.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection
entities.description: Protocol state where UE is registered but has no active PDN connection.

entities.name: No transport of user data during EPS bearer procedures
entities.description: MME and UE shall not initiate transport of user data via control plane until ongoing EPS bearer context procedure is completed.

entities.name: No transport of user data during transaction procedures
entities.description: MME and UE shall not initiate transport of user data via control plane until ongoing transaction procedure is completed, except for remote UE report and ESM information request.

relations.description: PDN connectivity procedure combined with attach triggers ESM information request procedure
ESM dummy message procedure requires EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection state
Successful transaction related procedure triggers network to execute EPS bearer context procedure
Condition prevents initiation of transport user data procedure during EPS bearer context procedures
Condition prevents initiation of transport user data procedure during transaction procedures
